s: Dine yoledet beshabbat ubo y"a seipim: yoledet hi kechola sheyyesh bah sakkana, umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat lekol mah shehi tzerika, qorin lah chakama mimmaqom lemaqom umeyalledin otah, uballayla madliqin lah hanner, apillu hi suma, vaapillu en hannashim hammitasseqot immah tzerikot lener, shehayu yekolot lehitasseq immah kol tzorkah belo ner — ap al pi ken madliqin bishbilah, sheap al pi shehi enah roa — mityashsheb libbah yoter kesheyyodaat sheyyesh kan ner, sheomeret belibbah "im yesh dabar hatztzarik li chabrotay root veosot li", mah sheen ken keshetteda sheen kan ner — yesh lachush shettistakken mippachad lebabah asher tipchad shemma en osin lah yapeh mah shehi tzerika. Umikkol maqom, hoil ukeeb hayyoledet debarim tibim hem, veen achat meelep meta mechamat leda, lepikak hechemiru chakamim leshannot bekol mah sheepshar leshannot, bo kegon im tzerikim lehabi lah keli derek reshut harabbim — tebiennu lah chabertah taluy bisarah, shehi hotzaa shello kedarkah, veen bah issur min hattora, veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Veim tzerika leshemen — lo tasuk chabertah shemen besaaroteha vetabo etzlah vetischot otan, ella tebiennu bikli taluy bisara, shemmutab laasot hotzaa bikli al yede shinnuy mibbeli issur acher millehosip issur sechita, ap al pi shessechitat sear enah asura ella middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"v:

Nokriyya en meyalledin otah beshabbat apillu bedabar sheen bo chillul shabbat, kegon shekkebar neeqar havvalad latzet, sheen behotzaato mishshum oqer dabar miggiddulo. Vegam hayyisreelit hi meyalledet yedua venotenim lah sakar, shemmuttar lah leyalled nokriyyot bechol mishshum eba, mikkol maqom beshabbat en kan eba, sheyyekola lehishshamet velomar "hannashim shellanu sheshshomerot et hashshabbat — muttar leyalled otan beshabbat, abal shellakem sheenan shomerim et hashshabbat — asur lanu leyalled otan beshabbat". Vaapillu yishmeelit sheenan obedim aboda zara (veen issur leyalled otan bechol kemo benokrim obede aboda zara, sheaseru otan mippene shemmeyalledet ben laaboda zara, mikkol maqom beshabbat) asur mishshum melaka shello letzorek, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"b (hoil veepshar lehishshamet beli eba). Abal haqqarai"m kevan shehem shomerim shabbat — muttar leyalled otan (besakar bedabar sheen bo chillul shabbat, mishshum eba). Vaapillu benokrim obede aboda zara, im i epshar lehishshamet beli eba — muttar bedabar sheen bo chillul shabbat:

Meematay niqret yoledet lechallel aleha et hashshabbat? Mishshettesheb al hammashber, o mishshaa shehaddam shotet veyored, o mishshaa shechabroteha noseot otah bizrooteha, sheen bah koach lahalok, kevan shennira echad mikkol ellu — mechallelim aleha hashshabbat lekol tzerakeha asher epshar laasotan kan beli ikkub, abal liqrot chakama mimmaqom lemaqom shehu dabar hatztzarik shahut veikkub — muttar miqqodem laken, mishshaa shemmargeshet qetzat, apillu besapeq. Vetob lizzaher shekkeshettaggia haishsha lechodesh t' yazmin hakkol meereb shabbat, kede shello yitztareku lechallel shabbat:

Kol g' yamim harishonim hi chashuba kimsukkenet vadday, mippene sheebareha mitporqim umerusseqet hi, lepikak mechallelim aleha et hashshabbat. Apillu omeret eni tzerika lechillul, ella shechabroteha omerot shetztzerika, apillu en bahen chakama velo rope — osin lah kol tzerakeha, shehaddebarim sheosim lachayya bechol yeduim hem lakkol. Vaapillu okelet maakal shear bene adam — anu omerim sheen margeshet lishatah, veim tokal tzonen o shear debarim sheen hammesukkenet okelet otam — yebiuha lide sakkana. Abal im chakama o rope omerim sheenah tzerika lechillul — shomeim lahem, ki harbeh yoledot yesh sheen osin lahen chammin bekol yom. Veken nohagim akshav biqtzat meqomot sheokelot beshabbat chammin shel etmol:

Mishshelosha vead sop shiba, omra "eni tzerika" — en mechallelin, apillu chabroteha omerot shetztzerika, lepi sheenah bechezqat mesukkenet leotan debarim shergilot chabroteha laasot lah bechol, veepshar sheyyekola lehamtin ad laereb. Ella im ken shechakama o rope omerim shetztzerika, sheaz mechallelin gam bishar cholim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"ch. Vekol zeh keshehi omeret "eni tzerika", abal bistam, shehi enah omeret kelum vechabroteha enan yodeot — mechallelin. Abal im chabroteha omerot sheenah tzerika — en mechallelin. Ella im ken hi omeret "tzerika ani", sheaz apillu mea ropeim omerim sheenah tzerika — mechallelin, ki "leb yodea marat napsho", ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman try"ch leinyan shear cholim. Umissop z' veelak, apillu omra "tzerika ani" — en mechallelin aleha, ella hare hi ad l' yom kecholeh sheen bo sakkana, shekkol tzerakayv naasim al yede nokri, chutz milleinyan medura, sheim hi tzerika lekak osim lah al yede yisrael, mippene shehatztzinna sakkana hi lah kol l' yom, vaapillu bitqupat tammuz. Veim muttarim acherim lehitchammem keneged medura zo — nitbaer besimman ra"v:

Yamim ellu en monin otam meet leet, ella im yolda bed' beshabbat samuk laereb — hare keshemmaggia techillat lel shabbat hu kebar yom rebii leledatah, ap al pi shello kalu g' meet leet ad samuk laereb beshabbat, veken leinyan shiba usheloshim:

Hayyoshebet al hammashber umeta — mebiin sakkin beshabbat, apillu derek reshut harabbim, veqorein et bitnah umotziin havvalad, shemma yimmatze chay. Veap al pi sherob happeamim hu met qodem leimmo, mikkol maqom bepiqquach nepesh en holekin achar harob velipamim yukal lichyot achar mitat immo. Veap al pi sheubbar zeh lo haya lo chezqat chayyut meolam — mechallelin alayv missapeq kemo al mi shehaya lo chezqat chayyut. Umah sheen nohagin ken akshav apillu bechol, mippene sheen anu beqiin bemitat haem beqarob kol kak sheepshar lavvalad lichyot, ki shemma nitallepa, veim yiqreu bitnah yemituha, utzerikim lehamtin, ubetok kak vadday met havvalad:

Havvalad shennolad beshabbat osin lo kol tzerakayv, marchitzin oto umolechin oto sheyyitqashsheh habbasar, vetomenin et hashshilya kede sheyyecham havvalad, vechotekim et hattabbur, shekkol debarim ellu yesh lo tzaar mehem im lo yaasu otam lo, vekevan sheen bahem melaka shel tora hittiru chakamim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bevalad shel qayyama, dehaynu shennolad let' o lez' bevadday (kegon shepperesh mimmenna balah achar shebbaal), abal nolad lech', o sapeq ben z' sapeq ben ch' — en mechallelin alayv, ben bidbarim ellu, ben apillu bidbarim sheyyesh bimniato sakkana lo, kegon lepaqqeach alayv et haggal. Ella im ken gameru searo vetzippornayv, sheaz bevadday nigmar lez', ella shennishtaha latzet mimmee immo achare gomro. Ulepikak apillu hu vadday ben ch', kegon shepperesh mimmenna balah achar shebbaal — hare dino keben z' vadday lekol dabar, umalin oto beshabbat. Abal im haya searo laquy veen tzippornayv shelemin kibriyyatan, apillu hu sapeq ben ch' — dino kevadday ben ch' lekol dabar, vaapillu leinyan piqquach nepesh shemmechallelin missapeq apillu al ubbar shello haya lo chezqat chayyut meolam, lepi shechosheshim shemma kalu lo chodashayv vegameru kebar searo vetzippornayv, abal zeh sheanu roin bo shello gameru — qarob levadday hu shehu ben ch', shello haya nigmar ad chodesh hat' umiher latzet qodem zemanno venepel hu. Vaapillu letaltelo asur, kemo sheasur letaltel et haeben, velaken en malin oto beshabbat. Veen omerim nimmol mimma napshak, im ben z' hu hare milato docha shabbat, veim ben ch' hu en kan chillul shabbat bemila zo shehare hu kimchattek basar bealma, shekkevan sheqqarob levadday shehu ben ch' — lo ratzu chakamim lehattir tiltul bishbil milato bemaqom sheqqarob levadday sheen milato kelum. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shekkevan sheepshar shehu ben z', vekol ben z' eno nepel ap al pi shello nigmeru searo vetzippornayv, velaken en issur kelal letaltelo beshabbat, veken malin oto beshabbat mimma napshak. Abal en mechallelin alayv shabbat ledibre hakkol, ben bedabar sheyyesh bo sakkana lo bimniato, ben bidbarim shehittiru laasot lavvalad beyom hivvoldo mishshum tzaaro, ap al pi sheen bahem melaka shel tora. Ulepi sebara zo malin akshav kol valad apillu nolad lech', ki en anu beqiin bechodshe haibbur, ki peamim shehaishsha mitabberet besamuk litbilatah, upeamim enah mitabberet ad achar kak, veepshar shehu ben z', veap al pi shello nigmeru searo vetzippornayv malin oto, veken muttar letaltelo beshabbat. (Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, velaken hammeqel betiltul kasbara haacharona — lo hipsid. Abal leinyan mila beshabbat — "sheb veal taaseh adip", vetob lachush ledibre haoserim. Veap sheen issur betiltulo — yesh issur bemilato beshabbat shello letzorek, kemo sheyyesh issur bachatikat hattabbur beshabbat ap lepi sebara haacharona, kemo shennitbaer):

Apillu ben ch' vadday sheasur betiltul ledibre hakkol, hare immo shocha alayv umeniqato, mippene tzaar hechalab shemmetzaarah. Veken hi beatzmah yekola lehotzi beyadah hechalab hamtzaer otah, shekkevan shehechalab hazzeh holek — leibbud en bo mishshum mepareq ella middibre soperim, umishshum tzaarah lo gazeru:

Meyashsherim ebere havvalad shel qayyama shennitparequ mechamat tzaar halleda. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom halleda, abal achar kak asur, mippene shennireh keboneh. Abal lekorko bibgadayv kede leyashsher ebarayv — muttar leolam, mippene sheddarko bekak gam bechol, veeno nireh keboneh beshabbat. Abal tinoq sheen korekin oto bechol venitaqqemu ebarayv beshabbat — asur lekorko kede leyashsheram:
Im nopla orlat haggaron shel havvalad — muttar lasum etzba letok piv ulesalleq haorla limqomah, ap al pi shillepaimayam yaqi al yede zeh:
